native.acceptance: Source-derived record only; historical captures are not redesign acceptance. No test or native runtime acceptance is asserted here.
native.colorGeneration: Dark seed#a87920, light seed#292e37 with authored overrides; remaining error roles SDK-generated. No wallpaper Dynamic Color.
native.surfaceRoles: surface/scaffold/canvas=base; low/high=raised; lowest/highest/secondaryContainer=inset; onSurface/onSecondaryContainer=text; onSurfaceVariant/secondary=secondary text; onSecondary=base; tertiary=primary; onTertiary=base
native.stateDetails: Fields use primary focus2dp and primary cursor/handles, selection alpha.24. Light primary is navy, dark amber. Disabled/error/native state layers, text/icon foreground inheritance and callback semantics are preserved.
native.previewPolicy: No HTML/CSS preview included; this sidecar is documentation, not a second implementation or browser acceptance baseline.

components.name: Native affirmative action
components.description: FilledButton48x52dp minimum, radius16dp; dark amber or light navy against onPrimary. Compact raised resting/inset pressed/flat disabled backgrounds preserve native semantics and foreground inheritance.

components.name: Native secondary action
components.description: OutlinedButton uses the neutral native neumorphic backgroundBuilder, 48x52dp minimum and radius 16dp. TextButton is 48x48dp minimum, radius 12dp. Compact/icon control minimum is 48x48dp.

components.name: Inset field
components.description: Native InputDecorator/NeoInputBorder,16dp radius/padding and2dp primary focus. Preserve labels, validation, selection, multiline/IME and anchored composer.

components.name: Native navigation
components.description: Phone joined Projects/New session(action)/Inbox. Selected bottom tab opens directly into matching body with no8dp gap/12dp connector band or closing seam; existing shoulders/recessed inactive controls remain. BothProjects/Inbox share this geometry. Top filters keep downward joins. Native Back/action/focus semantics and safe-area handling remain.

components.name: Native selected filter
components.description: Shared raised/inset/disabled roles and primary selected state; native keyboard/semantics and wrapping. Canlı uses actual workState across projects rather than process-open status.

components.name: Native contextual surfaces
components.description: NeoSurface default radius 20dp; menus raised 16dp; dialogs/sheet top corners raised 24dp with outlineVariant border and native confirmation/dismissal. Keep long transcripts/files/diffs flat. Snackbars use text background/base content.

narrative.overview: Graphite/fog neumorphism with dark amber and light navy action roles. Supplied Sisyphus art defines launcher and working GIF; quiet continuity cards and finite idle navigation serve local paired-PC work. Source documentation is not native acceptance.
keyCharacteristics: One neutral lighting model with raised, inset and flat depth
Native Roboto/Material roles and system text scale
Quiet flat reading planes and true inset inputs
Actual project/source/paired-PC identity, freshness and connection state
rules: First valid desktop or phone response wins; disconnected decisions are not silently queued.
Only pending, connected, valid, non-submitting requests are actionable; closed/expired requests stay read-only.
Keep source-session identity and durable memory distinct from live activity; finished turns are not finished projects.
Preserve draft ownership, acknowledged-version clearing, multiline growth, safe-area and IME anchoring.
Keep file/diff inspection read-only, diagnostics redacted, local Markdown free of remote fetches; host enforces project path confinement.
dos: Resolve brightness-specific semantic pairs through the theme
Keep native callbacks, touch targets, labels, focus and pressed/disabled states
Show status/failure/freshness in words as well as color
Retain reduced-motion and inactive/offscreen stop rules
Use canonical report for current acceptance and historical evidence
donts: Do not imply wallpaper Dynamic Color or invent authored measurements
Do not add glows or unrelated imagery/loops beyond the requested working GIF and idle-driven finite cards
Do not elevate every reading paragraph
Do not substitute historical screenshots for current native acceptance
Do not change trust/source/privacy/first-response boundaries through styling
